$comment: Labelled substitute set for retrieval recall@12 (Track B, F18). Each target is treated as out of stock; `acceptable` lists catalogue products a chef would accept for the target's normal use (grade same | close | functional), `nearMisses` look similar but must not be accepted. Availability and price are ignored. Labelled 14 Nov 2026 by LLM agents (Claude Sonnet) from catalogue names under a written rubric, spot-checked by session 1f; not chef-reviewed. Product ids reference the Valio catalogue; names are kept only for readability.
$kindNote: kind (substitution ladder, docs/research/substitutes.md): 1 same product, other pack (same brand and base name, fat % included) · 2 same base, other brand or variant · 3 other form or processing (frozen, trim, ready, raw) · 4 functional swap in the dish. Derived 14 Nov by session 91 from grade (functional → 4, close → 3, same → 1 or 2) and the catalogue's brand and normalised name; kind-1 rows hand-checked, the rest follow the labelled grade.
